text.p: - These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The National Assembly yesterday approved a budget of over 690 trillion kwanzas. The budget was approved by a vote of 124 to 55 abstentions.

- The U.N. Observer Mission and the "troika" observer nations to the peace process said yesterday that a new timetable submitted by UNITA to the Joint Commission for the extension of state administration was unacceptable.
